room_rent.note: Optional upgrade to Any Room or Twin Sharing AC Room available under Room Rent Modification (D.III.9). ICU covered at actuals up to SI.

icu.note: ICU covered at actuals up to Sum Insured by default.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base plan. Voluntary Co-Payment of 10%, 20%, or 30% available as optional cover (D.III.14). Additional 10% co-pay may apply for prolonged hospitalisation beyond 10 days without timely intimation; 20% for organ transplants at non-network hospitals without required intimation.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise sub-limits in base plan. Multifocal lenses and Femto Laser for cataract excluded (E.II.16). Organ donor complication support capped at 25% of BSI or ₹2L. Durable Medical Equipment (optional) capped at ₹1L/year. Maternity (optional) capped at 20% of BSI up to ₹5L.

deductible.note: Optional aggregate deductible (₹10K–₹10L) or daily deductible (₹1K–₹5K/day) available under D.III.13.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents or if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.note: Standard PED waiting period is 36 months. Reducible via portability/migration credits. Sarathi/Sarathi 2.0 optional covers reduce waiting to 30 days for declared Asthma, Diabetes, Dyslipidemia, Obesity, Hypertension.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Standard specific disease waiting period is 24 months (e.g. cataract, hernia, knee replacement, stones, etc.). Extendable to 36 months via optional cover D.III.16.

maternity.note: Covered up to 20% of BSI subject to max ₹5L per delivery; max 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime. Includes newborn expenses and first-year vaccinations within maternity SI. 36-month continuous coverage required before availing.

cumulative_bonus.note: Gullak (Guaranteed Cumulative Bonus) is an optional cover: 100% of BSI added per policy year irrespective of claims, up to maximum 1500% of BSI. No bonus if policy not renewed within grace period.

restoration.note: Optional cover (D.III.5): 100% of BSI restored unlimited times per year for same or unrelated illness/injury. Triggers only after SI (including Gullak) is exhausted; not available for first claim. Unutilised restored amount lapses at year end.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days prior to admission, up to SI.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days post discharge, up to SI.

day_care.note: All medically necessary day-care treatments covered up to SI.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days each. Restoration does not apply. Certain conditions excluded (asthma, COPD, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered up to SI in recognised AYUSH hospitals. Pleasure/rejuvenation therapies excluded.

organ_donor.note: Organ harvesting expenses, donor pre/post-hospitalisation (30 days each), donor screening (once/year for successful transplant), and donor complication support (25% of BSI up to ₹2L, independent limit) all covered.

ambulance.display: Up to SI (road); Air ambulance optional up to ₹10L
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to SI (D.I.6). Air ambulance is an optional cover (D.III.4) up to ₹10L per year, in addition to SI.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern/advanced procedures (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions, etc.) covered up to SI as inpatient or day care.

consumables.note: Non-medical items and durable medical equipment covered under optional cover D.III.15. Non-medical items up to SI; durable medical equipment up to ₹1L/year.

global_cover.note: Policy coverage is restricted to India only (F.II.5). Treatment outside India is a specific exclusion (E.II.8).

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim or policy can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace period for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium modes; 15 days for monthly mode.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; continuity credits for PED, specific waiting periods, moratorium and NCB transferred.

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, multifocal/femto-laser cataract lenses, OPD treatment, off-label drug use, adventure sports injuries, dental (unless accident+24hr hosp), external congenital anomaly

optional_riders.display: Gullak (cumulative bonus), Restoration, Anant (unlimited SI for cancer/heart/stroke/transplant/accident), Shakti/Surplus Benefit, Sarathi/Sarathi 2.0 (PED waiver), Air Ambulance, Maternity, Personal Accident, TTD, Health Check-up, Non-Medical Items cover, Deductible, Voluntary Co-pay, Room Rent Modification, Personal Accident Plus, OPD (Health 360)
